name: loancalculator-uitests
description: Appium server for the LoanCalculator cross-platform UI tests. Pinned so CI and local runs behave identically. Drivers are installed into ./.appium by `npm run drivers` (APPIUM_HOME is set per-script). `start` exports ANDROID_HOME because the UiAutomator2 driver needs it to find adb — a server started without it fails every Android session with 'Neither ANDROID_HOME nor ANDROID_SDK_ROOT environment variable was exported'.

scripts.drivers: APPIUM_HOME=./.appium appium driver install uiautomator2 && APPIUM_HOME=./.appium appium driver install xcuitest
